handler_open: New theater. Northern sector. Higher threat level. Your previous intel helped locate these targets.

targets.label: SUBMARINE
targets.handler_resolve: Sub forced to surface. Crew detained.

complication.handler_text: Sub is diving deeper. We're losing contact.

targets.label: AIRFIELD
targets.handler_classify: Small airfield. Cargo planes loading at night.
targets.handler_coa: Airfield is active. We can shut it down or watch.

coas.label: Hack
coas.handler_assign: Targeting their air traffic control system.

targets.label: SAFEHOUSE
targets.handler_detect: HUMINT reports activity at this location.
targets.handler_coa: HVT confirmed inside. Capture would be ideal.

coas.label: Observe
coas.handler_assign: Eyes on the building. Logging all visitors.

coas.label: Capture
coas.handler_assign: Strike team moving in. Breach in 60 seconds.

complication.handler_text: HVT is on the phone. If we wait, we trace the call. If we breach, we lose the intel.

targets.label: C2 NODE
targets.handler_classify: Command and control node. They're coordinating everything from here.
targets.handler_coa: This is their nerve center. Take it out and they go blind.
targets.handler_resolve: C2 node neutralized. Their network is dark.

coas.label: Jam
coas.handler_assign: Broadband jamming initiated. Everything goes dark.

complication.handler_text: Jamming is affecting our own comms. Partial blackout.
